description: This file defines the 'AnalysisOrchestratorService' class which coordinates multiple aspects of an analysis pipeline for resumes, including ATS checks, skills extraction, and generating recommendations. It interacts with various repositories and services to perform background and synchronous analysis tasks, manages analysis statuses, and creates recommendations based on candidate skills and job data.

classes.description: Service class that coordinates the entire resume analysis pipeline, handling ATS checks, skill extraction, suggestions, and recommendations.
